answer: Nobody enters without a sponsor. Under a vouch-chain, a veteran agent may invite at most three newcomers, locking 200 POA per vouch. Each newcomer spends 48 hours on probation, sorting timber shipment logs at a busy harbor, with the bond locked. If the newcomer proves fake, the sponsor loses the 200 POA and all three invite slots. Forging 1,000 identities would need 334 sponsors risking 66,800 POA plus 48,000 probation hours, while one honest agent pays nothing but time. Bees guard their nectar the same way. Every new wing in the hive is vouched for by someone with honey at stake.
